text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Vice-President Izzat Ibrahim lauds the emergency exercise carried out by members of the (ruling) Arab Baath Socialist Party in Baghdad to protect citizens and the glorious march of Baath revolution.
- President Saddam Hussein receives Vietnamese Deputy Prime Minister Phan Van Khai.
- Saddam receives letter from Russian prime minister.
- Justice Minister Shabib al-Maliki heads Iraqi delegation to the meeting of the Organisation of Islamic Conference in Islamabad.
- Egyptian daily al-Ahram criticises Rolf Ekeus chairman of the U.N. Special Commission on Iraq.
- Abdulsalam al-Majali to form new cabinet in Jordan.
- Vice-President Taha Muheiddin Ma'rouf receives Polish ambassador.
- Foreign minister receives Russian delegation headed by Fuel and Energy Minister Pyotr Rodionov.
- Foreign Minister Mohammed Saeed al-Sahaf receives Spanish diplomat.
(The above were also carried by AL-IRAQ and QADISSIYA)
- Commentary on surge of positive stand of world countries vis-a-vis Iraq.
- Commentary criticises U.S. plans to expand NATO.
- Commentary urges international community to press Iran to free Iraqi POWs.
